caption: The drawing features a full-length gown rendered in soft pink with light blue accents, depicted from the back. The dress is decorated with vertical bands of blue ribbon or trim, along with clusters of small, multicolored floral motifs in shades of pink, purple, and green scattered across the fabric. The sleeves are elbow-length and adorned with bands of blue ribbon, floral embroidery, and ruffled cuffs. The gown has a fitted bodice with a V-shaped back and additional pink and blue ribbon trim. To the left of the dress, there is a separate outline sketch of a sleeve with ruffled layers, annotated with text describing “shirred ribbon on sleeve, bustle and neck.” To the right of the dress, there are detailed drawings of the floral motifs and ribbon trim used on the gown, including pink and purple flowers with green leaves. The entire composition is sketched and painted on a light beige background, with the dress being the central, dominant object.
title: Dress
